recommendation_summary: Right now the reply sets one rule in the existing tracker: while the lead is away, one approval from either of the two authorized engineers is enough. It also reassigns all open reviews that are waiting on the lead to those two engineers today. It suggests no optional additions and leaves no needs unmet. Squads/chapters, Jira Align, new tooling and quarterly workshops are explicitly removed.

The requirement with a cause is yours: changes stop waiting when the lead is absent.
